findings.problem: The example is two sentences, but it should be one short sentence.
findings.fix: example.target: Entschuldigung, noch einmal, bitte. | example.en: Sorry, once more, please.

back.target: Once more, please. / One more time, please.
back.example: I don't understand that. Once more, please.

note: People often shorten it to "Noch mal, bitte." (or "Nochmal, bitte."), so you could accept that as a variant of the same answer.
